en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a monumental architectural gateway with a very large central arch flanked by engaged columns and blind arcades. The façade is heavily stylized, with multiple rectangular window-like recesses above, decorative friezes, and smaller arched niches below. The scene appears to be indoors, possibly a museum gallery, with stone slabs or sculptures visible through the dark opening behind the arch. There is a wide, empty floor area in the foreground and no visible people or text on the image.
